text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Bar: share of the MW moved by injected transfers that the detector finds. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole calendar months. Transfers of 25% to 40% of the receiving load lasting over 1 day that start in even months; constant-MW and receiver-profile shapes pooled; every detector raises the same number of false alarms on odd months.'
